subject: Renewal & capacity commitment — consolidate billing recipient and EFT onboarding
messages:
From: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@storics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@storics.com
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity commitment — billing recipient change and EFT?

Rachel — thanks for the quick call earlier. Storics is ready to move forward with the 12-month renewal + 150k token capacity uplift we discussed. Two billing items to align so Finance can issue a PO:

- Please consolidate invoicing to our corporate AP inbox (accounts-payable@storics.com) and direct statements to: Finance Lead, Storics, 210 Harbor Dr, Palo Alto, CA 94301.
- Our procurement team will issue a PO (attached) and would like Net 60 terms. Can you confirm Redwood accepts Net60 for this committed capacity?
- They prefer ACH/EFT for payments — can you share your EFT onboarding instructions and the bank details form we need to complete?
- Attached: W9_Storics_2027.pdf and PO_Storics_Redwood_2027_signed.pdf (signed by Storics procurement).

If you need a signed amendment on your side or a PO acknowledgement, loop me and our AP. We need invoices to be issued to the AP email and reference PO #S-2027-112.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Baxter
Head of Procurement, Storics, Inc.
Mobile: +1 650 555 0142
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity commitment — billing recipient change and EFT?

Tom — got it, and congrats on the expansion. I confirm receipt of the PO and W-9. Next steps from our side: 

1) I will route the PO to Billing Ops for Net60 review (we typically support Net30/Net45 on self-serve, Net60 requires finance approval for a renewed committed contract).
2) Please confirm the legal entity name and EIN exactly as it should appear on invoices (matching your W-9). That prevents delays in our AR system.
3) I've attached our PO acknowledgement template (Redwood_PO_Ack_template.pdf). Sign/return or let me know if you need us to countersign.
4) For ACH/EFT, we accept vendor onboarding via our secure portal. I will kick off the EFT onboarding once Finance approves the Net60 request — below are the items we need from you:
   - Legal entity name + EIN (matching W-9)
   - AP contact full name + phone + AP email (you already included accounts-payable@storics.com)
   - Completed EFT form (I can send the portal link or an offline PDF if preferred)

I am looping in Karthik to confirm the Net60 exception flow and timing. Marissa, please keep an eye on this for SLA and to prioritize the committed capacity rollout.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198

Attachment: Redwood_PO_Ack_template.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity commitment — billing recipient change and EFT?

Hi team — quick note on the approval path for Net60 and the PO: 

- Finance policy: Net60 on committed contracts is allowed with senior finance sign-off for deals > $100k ARR. I will review and aim to respond within 48 business hours.
- Once approved, Billing Ops will send Redwood_EFT_Onboarding_Instructions.pdf (secure portal link) and the bank verification steps. We require a scanned EFT form and a bank micro-deposit verification (standard).
- PO acknowledgement: Rachel, please have the customer sign the attached template so Billing Ops can match the PO# to the contract.

Tom — to avoid any delays, please reply with the exact invoice payee as it should appear on invoices and confirm the PO number to be referenced S-2027-112. If Storics prefers a specific invoice frequency for committed capacity (monthly/quarterly), state that as well.

Karthik
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@storics.com>

Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity commitment — billing recipient change and EFT?

Thanks Karthik — confirmed items below so we can move quickly:

- Invoice payee: Storics, Inc. (EIN: 94-1234567) — matches attached W-9.
- AP contact: Dana Li, dana.li@storics.com, +1 650 555 0201; accounts-payable@storics.com (primary inbox).
- PO#: S-2027-112 (attached). Invoice frequency: monthly invoices for committed capacity + one upfront invoice for the committed prepay if Redwood requires it.
- We prefer ACH; please confirm whether Redwood can accept ACH and if the portal supports uploading a bank letter of authorization.

Attached: W9_Storics_2027.pdf, PO_Storics_Redwood_2027_signed.pdf

If finance needs a signed amendment showing Net60 explicitly, we can sign that today. Otherwise we'll wait for the PO acknowledgement and EFT link.

Best — Tom
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity commitment — billing recipient change and EFT?

Tom — appreciate the quick confirmation and the attachments. Summary and next steps: 

- I've confirmed invoice payee = Storics, Inc. (EIN 94-1234567). Billing Ops will update the payee and invoice recipient to accounts-payable@storics.com and Dana Li.
- Karthik will follow up on Net60 approval; if approved, we will annotate the contract and issue invoices on Net60 terms. If Finance requires a countersigned amendment, I'll route the DocuSign and will copy your procurement contact.
- EFT/ACH: we accept ACH. I'll start the EFT onboarding in our portal. You should receive a secure onboarding link from billing@redwood.com with steps to upload the bank letter + form. Expect the micro-deposit verification within 48-72 hours of submission.
- PO acknowledgement: please sign and return the Redwood_PO_Ack_template.pdf (attached earlier). Once Billing Ops receives the signed ack + EFT docs, they will create the billing profile and schedule invoices for the renewed commitment.

I will also request a priority SLA for provisioning the extra capacity once finance signs off — Marissa, please prioritize the deployment checklist so Storics can start using the uplift on the renewal effective date.

Thanks all — I will update this thread when the EFT link is sent.

Rachel Kim
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198
